from datetime import datetime, timedelta

start_date = datetime(2025, 6, 25)
holidays = {
    datetime(2025, 7, 1),
    datetime(2025, 7, 21),
    datetime(2025, 9, 1),
    datetime(2025, 9, 8)
}

# Generate dates from start for 100 days
dates = [start_date + timedelta(days=i) for i in range(100)]

# Filter to business days (Monday=0 through Friday=4 are weekdays)
business_days = [d for d in dates if d.weekday() < 5 and d not in holidays]

# Get the 18th business day (index 17)
result = business_days[17]

print(f"ANSWER: {result.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
